label_definitions.citation_overreach: Judge marks one or more cited regulations/sanctions lists as incorrect (incorrect_citations non-empty).
label_definitions.requirement_miss: Judge marks one or more required compliance obligations as wrong or missing (requirements_wrong non-empty).
label_definitions.metric_accuracy_loss: Lowest sub-metric is Metric Accuracy (MA): missing benchmarks, ratios, or quantitative targets.
label_definitions.terminology_incomplete: Lowest sub-metric is Terminology Fidelity (TF): omits required domain terms.
label_definitions.reasoning_incoherence: Lowest sub-metric is Reasoning Coherence (RC): thin or unsound argument structure.
label_definitions.instability: Lowest sub-metric is Response Stability (RS): inconsistent or unreliable output across the rubric.
label_definitions.verbosity_bloat: Coordination response length >= 1.5x the paired single-agent response length.
